entries.ec4e9c08856d3: $~Jab koi kisi paigham ko jaanchta hai, to woh ab bata sakta hai ke usne kaun se usool toray aur ek note bhi likh sakta hai jo faisle ke saath aap tak aata hai. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.ee91e4f4b0c11: $~Aapke notifications ab qaayim rehte hain: reload ke baad bhi rehte hain, doosre devices par aapke saath jaate hain, aur jab aap unhein saaf kar dein to saaf hi rehte hain. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.ebb873337b26a: $~Aap jo baantte hain use kaun jaanchta hai, ab is par munhasir hai ke use kaun dekh sakta hai, aur <huqooq ka safha@https://wordplay.dev/rights> sab kuch samjhata hai. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e1705ef65675f: $~Ab jab tak koi kisi shikaayat shuda paigham ko jaanchta hai, hum use poori tarah chhupa dete hain, sirf screen par chhupane ke bajaye. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.ee2c17af3b60f: $~Kisi paigham ki shikaayat use sirf ek baar chhupati hai, is liye koi baar baar shikaayat kar ke kisi ko khamosh nahin kara sakta. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e49910e21af53: $~Report kiye gaye paighaam ab baqi sab cheezon ke saath moderation page par jaanch ke liye intezaar karte hain, aur aap ki notifications aap ko wahin le jaati hain. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e8a2192c0f73e: $~Collaborate tile ab un sab logon ko ek table mein dikhati hai jo aap ki mansooba tak pahunch sakte hain. Ek menu se har shakhs ko collaborate, comment, view ya owner banane ka ikhtiyaar milta hai.
entries.ec340cb6a8402: $~Ab chat baat karne se shuru hoti hai: tile kholte hi paighaam ka box tayyar hota hai, aur pehla paighaam bhejte hi chat ban jaati hai.

entries.e9086ec6be82d: $~"Paighaam ka tarjuma karein" aur "Main likh raha hoon" ke menus ab paighaam ke box ke upar ek hi line mein saath hain, aur har ek ke saath talaash nahin hai.
entries.e55c357643d75: $~Wordplay mein jahan bhi logon ki fehrist hoti hai, ab wahan ek hi table istemaal hoti hai, is liye shamil karna aur hataana har jagah ek jaisa hai. Lambi fehristein chhoti karne ke liye yeh ek qataar mein do ya zyada log rakhti hai.
entries.e8e96a3a64860: $~Aap ki notifications ab sign out karne ke baad nahin rehtin. Share kiye gaye computer par agla shakhs woh tanbeehat dekh sakta tha jo aap ke liye thin. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e782142100132: $~How-to notifications band karne se ab aap ki baqi saari notifications saaf nahin hotin. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e0c9b117ed451: $~Ab aap ko un paighaamon ka bhi pata chalta hai jo aap ke jaane ke dauran aaye, sirf unka nahin jo page khula hone par aaye. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.ed8006c604309: $~Ek mansooba mein kai report kiye gaye paighaam ab kai notifications ki surat mein nazar aate hain, ek aisi notification ki jagah jo kabhi khatam nahin hoti thi. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.ef0519ca44b91: $~Chat ke paighaam par report ka jhanda ab har paighaam ka report box ek saath nahin kholta. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e072fdfb6068a: $~Ek hi cheez ko do baar report karne se ab do reports nahin banti. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e1cfdf4680dd9: $~Ab sirf mansooba ka malik uski chat mita sakta hai, chat mein maujood har shakhs nahin. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e7f6016c635fe: $~Ab har shakhs ka sirf ek ikhtiyaar hota hai, is liye koi shakhs collaborate tile mein do baar nahin dikhta, aur purani mansooba pehli baar kuch bhi badalne par khud theek ho jaati hai.
entries.e5e34ff0b8788: $~Jab aap aisa naam likhte hain jo hum istemaal nahin kar sakte, to wajah batane wala paighaam ab sab cheezon ke upar, box ke bilkul neeche nazar aata hai, kat jaane ya button ke peeche chhup jaane ke bajaye.
entries.e603d548cad47: $~Screen readers ab un boxes mein jahan kai satron ki tehreer hoti hai, yeh bhi parh kar sunate hain ke naam kyun radd hua.
entries.e054146a10d97: $~Ab aap <numaish gahon@https://wordplay.dev/galleries> mein talaash kar sakte hain: ek lafz likhein aur milti julti numaish gahen, misaali mansoobe, aur share ki gayi numaish gahon ke mansoobe dekhein. (<299@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/299>)
entries.eba2348e140c6: $~Apni numaish gah ko fehrist mein daalna ab ek darkhwast hai jise moderator dekhta hai. Aap ki numaish gah ka page batata hai ke woh intezaar mein hai, fehrist mein hai, ya radd ho gayi, aur tabdeeli par aap ko ittela milti hai. (<1311@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1311>)
entries.ea93449b22f62: $~Chhe misaalein jo kisi numaish gah mein nahin thin ab ek mein hain, taake aap unhein dhoondh saken: Adobo Recipe, Color Show, Laughing, Layouts, Mumble, aur Wild Transforms.
entries.ea9e054710764: $~Ab aap lughat ke lafz ke doosre hijje bhi shamil kar sakte hain, taake \@parameters\ jaisa link poora lafz sambhaal le, aur mutarjimeen ke liye naya Glossary tab hai jahan woh inhein shamil aur hata sakte hain. (<1244@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1244>)
entries.eea11050ebd13: $~Humne lughat ka lafz ya uska matlab theek karna aasaan bana diya hai: ab aap use <Rehnuma@https://wordplay.dev/guide> mein jahan woh nazar aata hai wahin badal sakte hain, lambi tehreer ki fehrist mein dhoondhne ke bajaye. (<1244@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1244>)
entries.e6138d0834ca8: $~Agar aap Wordplay ka tarjuma karne mein madad karte hain, to ab aap code ke masle ke baare mein editor ke dikhaye gaye nukaat theek kar sakte hain, yaani masle ka chhota naam bhi aur use samjhane wala jumla bhi, wahin jahan aap unhein parhte hain, lambi fehrist mein dhoondhne ke bajaye. Jumle ke woh hisse jo woh khud bharta hai, jaise ghalat cheez ka naam, aap ke badalne ke dauran apni jagah rehte hain, aur mehfooz karne ke baad nukta dobara aam tarah parha jaata hai. (<1275@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1275>)
entries.e5b5b6d032c59: $~Isi tarah ab aap woh bhi theek kar sakte hain jo editor kisi code ke tukde ke baare mein kehta hai, aur har bane bane cheez ka madad ka matn, jahan bhi woh nazar aaye. (<1275@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1275>)
entries.e27e31d0327cc: $~Numaish gah mein share kiye gaye tareeqa guide ab <Rehnuma@https://wordplay.dev/guide> mein baqi ke saath hain, us numaish gah ke neeche jama jisne unhein share kiya. (<1277@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1277>)
entries.e82d0f81cac3d: $~Numaish gahon ka page ab har baar nayi tarteeb mein aam numaish gahen dikhata hai, aur jab abhi koi fehrist mein na ho to yeh bata deta hai. (<1311@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1311>)
entries.e2909f3fbc5d3: $~Localization mode mein, edit button ab sirf wahin nazar aata hai jahan waqai kuch badalna ho. (<1275@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1275>)
entries.e9ad8767d59a7: $~Dark mode mein, talaash ke nateeje mein numayaan lafz ab itna gehra hai ke apne peele pas-manzar par saaf parha ja sakta hai.
entries.e11b76456f175: $~Humne <sabaq@https://wordplay.dev/learn> mein Python, JavaScript, aur Java ke namoone har zubaan mein waise hi kar diye jaise woh likhe jaate hain.
entries.e75875093e046: $~Takreeban 50 sabaq ki satrein aap ko kuch aazmaane ko kehti thin magar dikhati nahin thin — ek jumla jis mein \+\ ka istemaal likha tha lekin \+\ maujood nahin tha. Humne Portuguese, Spanish, Hindi, aur Chinese mein woh gum shuda misaalein wapas daal di hain.
entries.e7624705a3c68: $~Spanish aur Chinese sabaq mein, humne woh satrein hata di hain jo kuch kirdaar do baar kehte thay.
entries.ee13189b51a5c: $~Zubaan ke tag sikhane wali misaalon ke tag har zubaan mein kho gaye thay, aur \'hello'\ ki jagah \'hello'/en\ dikhaya ja raha tha. Ab woh dobara apna maqsad sikhati hain, aur jo matn dusri zubaan mein hi rehna chahiye woh ab tarjuma ho kar zaaya nahin hota.
entries.e1a2d93fef84b: $~Moseeqi banane, khel ka hisaab rakhne, aur video grid ke tareeqa guide ab har zubaan mein naye hain.
entries.ee7a9112b7f8c: $~Humne woh naam theek kiye jo ghalat lafz mein tarjuma ho gaye thay, taake aap woh likh sakein jo <rehnuma@https://wordplay.dev/guide> mein dikhaya gaya hai. Gyarah zubaanon mein us cheez ki qism ka lafz jo list mein hoti hai, meherbaan hone ka lafz ban gaya tha, Polish mein \Set\ cheezon ko tarteeb dene ka fail ban gaya tha, aur paanch Hebrew naamon mein aise nishaan thay jo koi nahin likhta. (<1324@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1324>)
entries.ee29500571349: $~@Phrase ko \bubble\ dein to woh us ki taraf ishaara karte hue baat ke bubble mein bolta hai; alfaaz daalein, bolne ke liye @Say, ya rang chunne ya use khayal banane ke liye @Bubble dein. (<75@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/75>)
entries.e7404f9fdc62e: $~Bubble bolne wale ke upar ya saath apni jagah khud dhoondta hai, aur aap ka stage jagah bana deta hai taake yeh kabhi screen se bahar na ho. (<75@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/75>)
entries.e0540614e717a: $~Humne <numaish gah@https://wordplay.dev/galleries> mein Dialog naam ki ek nayi misaal shaamil ki hai, jis mein do harf is baat par baat karte hain ke harfon ka baat karna kitna ajeeb hai. (<75@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/75>)
entries.e1c506ceee5f0: $~@Row ab apna mawaad baseline par barabar kar sakta hai, yaani woh lakeer jis par harf tikte hain, taake ek chhota \a\ aur ek lamba \b\ do lakeeron ki bajaye ek lakeer ki tarah parhe jaayein. Safoon ki tarteeb ke liye \_\ chunein.
entries.edc2e7b1223ec: $~Har font ab bata deta hai ke woh kaisa dikhta hai, harf ki shakal ke liye 12 alfaaz aur ehsaas ke liye 13, jo Wordplay ki har zubaan mein tarjuma kiye gaye hain. (<298@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/298>)
entries.e66b9b9fb8182: $~Kisi cheez ko dusri ke qareeb khinchein to woh us ke kinaron, beech, ya baseline se chipak jaati hai, aur ek lakeer mel dikhati hai; grid on ho to woh grid se chipakti hai, aur Alt ya Option se aap use kahin bhi rakh sakte hain. (<117@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/117>)
entries.ed22be03fc599: $~Teer wali kunjiyan jo cheez aap ne chuni hai use hilati hain, aur shift dabane se woh agli cheez tak chhalaang lagati hai jis ke saath woh barabar ho sakti hai, aur Wordplay batata hai ke woh kahan pahunchi. (<117@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/117>)
entries.e0893676698af: $~Palette mein ab sab se upar + buttons ki ek qataar hai jis se aap apne stage par jumla, mustateel, daaira, kai pehlu wali shakal, lakeer, moseeqi, ya baat shaamil kar sakte hain.
entries.e25ae8a0e7f65: $~Nayi cheez aap ke stage par maujood cheezon ke neeche aati hai aur Wordplay use chun leta hai taake aap use foran badal sakein; agar aap ne pehle kuch chuna ho to woh us ke saath aati hai.
entries.ef5e5847cfd04: $~Apne stage par do ya zyada cheezein chunein aur unhein @Group mein jama karne ke liye 🔳 dabayein. Jab aisa na ho sake to button wajah batata hai. (<119@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/119>)
entries.ec4aeeea3bfec: $~Ab aap sirf mustateel hi nahin, daaira ya kai pehlu wali shakal bhi bana sakte hain, aur har shakal ko \▭\, \●\, ya \⬢\ likh sakte hain.
entries.eb7ad973482e4: $~Ab aap apne stage par bana sakte hain: pencil dabayein, phir lakeer ke liye khinchein ya har mod ke liye click karein, mouse ke baghair banane ke liye teer wali kunjiyan aur Enter istemaal karein, aur khatam karne ke liye Escape dabayein. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e2a8ce685236b: $~Ek lakeer banane ke baad pencil band ho jati hai taake aap ghalti se doosri shuru na kar dein; agar aap ka program khaali ho to yeh aap ko banane ke liye ek @Stage de deta hai. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.ed44130ff0fd4: $~Ek nayi shakal, @Path, jaghon ki list se ek lakeer guzaarti hai, aur aap use \╱\ likh sakte hain. Aakhri jagah ko pehli se milane ke liye \closed\ maangein, jaghon par mudne ki bajaye un se ghoomte hue guzarne ke liye \smooth\, aur yeh batane ke liye ke kitni moti banani hai \thickness\. Yeh jaghon ki saadi list leti hai, is liye jo bhi jagahein banaye woh ek bana sakta hai — @Contour samet, jo harfon ka khaka kheenchta hai. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e415caf1fb749: $~Apni banayi hui lakeer chunein aur us ke handles khinchein ya teer wali kunjiyan istemaal karke use modein, beech mein ek jagah jorne ke liye Enter dabayein, aur ek hatane ke liye Delete. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e9677e5f3097a: $~Aap ke @Stage par @Path ab cheezon ko us ki asli shakal se rokta hai, taake aap pahaadi ya wadi bana kar dekh sakein ke cheezein us mein lurhakti hain. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e1edaf8d76442: $~Kisi shakal ko \glyphs\ dein aur Wordplay woh matn us ke kinare par baar baar likhta hai, taake alfaaz daaire ke gird chal sakein ya harfon se lakeer banayi ja sake. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e760f1bb49f86: $~Shapes ab \filled\ aur \stroked\ rakhti hain, is liye aap sirf ek kinara rakh sakte hain, ya dono nahin. Isi tarah aap aisi deewar banate hain jo cheezon ko rokti hai magar nazar nahin aati.
entries.efdd7f448264d: $~Ab aap zubaan ke tag mein sirf code hi nahin, balki zubaan ka naam bhi likh sakte hain: \'hola'/Español\, \'hola'/Spanish\, aur \'hola'/es\ sab ka matlab ek hi hai, aur \/es-México\ aur \/es-MX\ ka bhi. Bade harf aur nishaan ka koi farq nahin parta, is liye \/espanol\ bhi chalta hai. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e7eb71f8ff482: $~Ab Wordplay aap ko batata hai jab use zubaan ke tag mein ilaaqa samajh nahin aata, jaise woh pehle se zubaan ke liye karta tha. Pehle \/en-Merica\ jaisi ghalat likhi hui cheez chupchaap bekaar ho jaati thi. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e30b0c78ef797: $~Ab aap zubaan ka tag adha likh kar bhi mukammal kar sakte hain. \/esp\ likhein aur \/español\ chunein, \/span\ likhein aur \/Spanish\ chunein, ya \/en-U\ likhein aur \/en-US\ chunein. Jab aap kuch likh dete hain to har zubaan aur ilaaqa samne aata hai, sirf woh nahin jo Wordplay bolta hai. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e7f8b348cd7ac: $~Teen misaalein ab haath se rakhe hue alfaaz ki jagah bolne wale bubbles istemaal karti hain: woh naqsha jo kisi jagah se takraane par us ke baare mein batata hai, woh chehra jo aap ka mizaaj batata hai, aur kahani Pears. (<75@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/75>)
entries.e786e5ca323da: $~Jab aap ka program ek se zyada cheezein dikhata hai, to woh bilkul wahin jaati hain jahan aap rakhte hain. Pehle Wordplay chupchaap unhein @Group mein jama karke upar neeche rakh deta tha. Is se aap ki likhi har jagah ka upar neeche wala hissa zaaya ho jaata tha aur idhar udhar wala hissa bhi hil jaata tha. Jin cheezon ki apni koi jagah nahin hoti woh ab beech mein ek doosre ke upar rehti hain. Is liye unhein jagah dein, ya agar aap upar neeche rakhna chahte the to khud @Group likhein.
entries.ea30aba547270: $~<zubaan chunne wala@https://wordplay.dev/> ab har ilaaqe ko us ki apni zubaan mein likhta hai, is liye aap "México" aur "日本" dekhenge. Aap ab bhi kisi bhi naam se talaash kar sakte hain. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.ecaba766bb2c1: $~Jab aap menu se zubaan ka tag chunte hain, to ab woh zubaan ka naam batata hai. Is liye \/es\ "español" parha jaata hai aur \/es-MX\ "español (México)". (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e36a774e1e335: $~Zubaan likhne ke baad ab hum woh jagahein dikhate hain jahan log woh zubaan bolte hain. \/en\ par \-US\, \-GB\, aur \-CA\ samne aate hain. Doosri zubaan jodna ab bhi neeche maujood hai. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e15c0e192cf34: $~Font chunne wala ab nishaanon ko "no light, bold, extra, italic" parhta hai aur sahara kiye gaye likhne ke nizaam ko "Greek" parhta hai, jabke nishaan aur harf ab bhi nazar aate hain. (<298@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/298>)
entries.ecbd9d246842b: $~Humne aapke stage par woh clicks theek kar diye jo pehle kuch select nahin karte the aur sirf neela khaaka dikhate the, lekin na handles aate the na arrow keys se hilna hota tha.
entries.eca4cab5a30dc: $~Ab jab aap kisi cheez ko kheenchte hain to aapka stage rukaa rehta hai, aur jab aap chhorte hain to woh aapke kaam ke hisaab se dobara set ho jaata hai; sab kuch naye sire se dikhane ke liye apna program dobara shuru karein.
entries.e7aa56c60cc2d: $~Screen readers ab shakl ki nishani parhne ke bajaye "group" ya shakl ka lafz bolte hain, jaise "white square button".
entries.e363350f72f2f: $~Jab ek language tag ek hi ilaaqe ka naam do baar likhe, to usay theek karne par ab sirf dohrayi hui cheez hatati hai, aapke baqi ilaaqe nahin. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.ead3d948efccc: $~Menu ab language tag likhne mein madad karta hai: \'hi'/\ zubaanein dikhata hai, \'hi'/en\ ilaaqe dikhata hai, aur \'hi'/en-U\ usay \/en-US\ mein mukammal karta hai. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e50f1c2a08ebb: $~Apne program mein kuch shamil karne par pehle aapki mansooba ki tafseel aapke code ki pehli line par chali jaati thi.
entries.ed93a2b1c05d8: $~Ab @Say chunne par aap palette mein uska matn kisi bhi aur cheez ki tarah badal sakte hain.
entries.ebabff67170ad: $~Chhoti shakl ka khaaka, uske ghoomne aur size badalne ke handles, aur khud shakl ab ek hi jagah par barabar nazar aate hain, alag alag jagah par nahin.
entries.e84362a0cf17f: $~Humne woh masla theek kiya jab aapke stage ke \frame\ ke taur par istemaal hone wala gol ya kaii kinaaron wala shakl stage ka ghalat hissa kaat deta tha.
entries.e3e061f59b902: $~Settings mein evaluation cues on karein to Wordplay aapka program chalne par har baar ek chhoti awaaz nikaalta hai, aur har input ki awaaz alag hoti hai. Time slider ka daura unki wazahat karta hai. (<537@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/537>)
entries.eb0685942f760: $~Collision cues on karein to aap apne stage par cheezon ke takraane ki awaaz sun sakte hain: zor se takraana zyada tez awaaz deta hai, aur kaii cheezon ka ek saath girna kaii cheezon jaisi awaaz deta hai.
entries.e9e7ab5b65f52: $~Animation cues on karein to aap animation ko sun sakte hain: ghoomne se awaaz ka sur badalta hai, hilne se awaaz ek taraf se doosri taraf jaati hai, aur ghaib hone par awaaz dheemi hoti jaati hai. Baar baar chalne wali animation har baar wohi dhun bajati hai.
entries.ef02d7f20fbdb: $~Ab ek \@Pose\ ke saath ek \@Music\ ho sakta hai jo usi lamhe bajta hai jab woh pose hota hai, chahe aap usay le kar dakhil hon ya \@Sequence\ ke andar us tak pahunchein. (<22@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/22>)

entries.eaea74cea0e1a: $~Aap note ke saath hi likh sakte hain ke woh kitni der chalega, likhi hui music ki shaklein istemaal karke: \3𝅗𝅥\ aadha note hai aur \3𝅘𝅥𝅮\ aathwan hissa. entries.e319ba829909f: $~Is hafte humne screen reader ki rasaai par kaam kiya!

entries.e21f3ea5d2e3c: $~Jab stage par kuch hilta hai, to ab hum batate hain ke woh kis taraf gaya aur kahan pohancha, jaise "cat 2m 1m par oopar aur daayein hila", sirf "hila" kehne ke bajaye. entries.e1b0d145c7c38: $~Aapki dabayi hui kunji ke jawab ab foran bolte hain, aur khabrein jaise mukammal hui download apni baari ka intezaar karti hain, taake paighaam ek doosre par na bolein.
entries.e7664851e2a5a: $~Jab aap ek se zyada zubaanein chunte hain, to bole jaane wale label ab sirf aapki pehli zubaan istemaal karte hain.

entries.eadac2f4a99bf: $~Humne har qism ke code ke apne aap ko bayan karne ka tareeqa ek jaisa likh diya: qeematein batati hain ke woh kya hain, jaise "5 meters" ya "true", aur izhaar batate hain ke woh kya karte hain, jaise "Phrase chalayein" ya "true par shart".
entries.e636027153886: $~Screen reader ab emoji nahin bolte jab code ka likha hua naam bhi ho: jis function ka naam 💬 aur Phrase dono hai, woh ab "Phrase" kehta hai. Emoji sirf tab bolte hain jab kisi cheez ka wahi ek naam ho.
entries.eb3b6bf17c8e4: $~Ek lafz mein likhe naam, jaise \eyesOpen\, ab alag alag lafz "eyes open" ki tarah parhe jaate hain, taake ooncha sun kar samajhna aasaan ho.

entries.ea83808e5f5be: $~Wazahat ke hisse ab batate hain ke woh kya rakhte hain: zubaan aur lafzon ki ginti, matn, aur code. (<1252@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1252>)
entries.eef5aa017ac4d: $~Namoone ke hisse ab bhi batate hain ke woh kya rakhte hain: capture apna naam batata hai, theek matn apne huroof batata hai, aur silsila apne donon sire batata hai. (<1252@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1252>)
entries.e0b0b90415539: $~Mansooba chalte waqt dabayi gayi kunjiyan ab jawab ki tafseel ko nahin rokti, aur alert ki awaaz bhi nahin nikaalti.
entries.e285bb32bb563: $~Jahan code gayab ho wahan \~\ ya \-\ jaisa amil likhne par ab khaali jagah lag jati hai aur aapka cursor us par aa jata hai, to \~\ ban jata hai \~_\. Yeh har us jagah kaam karta hai jahan code ki umeed ho, jaise khaali program, \(\ ya \[\ ke andar, ya \⊤ &\ ke baad.
entries.e8aac8a17a293: $~Adhoori reaction ab batati hai ke woh kis hisse ka intezaar kar rahi hai, jaise "shart gayab hai", "na parhne laayak code" kehne ke bajaye. Woh chalti bhi hai, aur jab tak aap use mukammal na karein apni shuru ki qeemat par rehti hai.
entries.e19df165bf0f6: $~Humne woh masla theek kiya jis mein mansoobe jam jaate the jab aap unke chalte waqt code badalte the.
entries.ed71f652394f0: $~Humne halke matn ko parhna aasaan banaya: links, galti ke paighaam, aur dhundhle alfaaz roshan mode mein gehre aur andhere mode mein roshan hain. (<1183@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1183>)
entries.eeb1e077576a3: $~Humne woh masla theek kiya jis mein editor mitate waqt khamosh rehta tha: ab har mitana us harf ko bolta hai jo hataya gaya, aur bade mitane wali cheezein sab kuch batati hain jo gayab hua.
entries.efc1e19bc5be8: $~Humne woh masla theek kar diya jis mein cursor line ke aakhir par pahunchta to editor oonchi aawaaz mein "Unparsable template" kehta tha.
entries.ed649bc4cba1c: $~Humne woh masla theek kar diya jis mein cursor wazahat ke andar \$name\ par aata to screen reader be-matlab number bolta tha. Ab woh naam bolta hai. (<1252@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1252>)
entries.ef5e786f9d753: $~Humne ek cheez wali chizon ki ginti theek kar di: jis list mein ek cheez ho woh ab "list of 1 value" kehti hai, aur har zubaan mein sahi ginti aati hai. (<1250@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1250>)
entries.eb52b656106d9: $~Humne tamam 30 zubaanon ki wazahaton mein 545 toote hue link theek kar diye, jo us lafz ki jagah khaali dibba dikhate the jis ki taraf woh ishara karte the. (<1245@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1245>)

entries.e7c165dd8e3c3: $~Humne woh masla theek kar diya jis mein keyboard se dibba band karne par aap page ke sab se oopar pahunch jaate the. Ab aap usi button par wapas aate hain jis se aap ne dibba kholа tha.
entries.e1326abc63656: $~Humne har page ko ek unwaan de diya, taake browser ke tab aur screen reader bata sakein ke aap kaun se page par hain.
entries.ececbd2f2909f: $~Humne woh masla theek kar diya jis mein screen reader stage ki cheezein do baar bolta tha: ek baar "output phrase hi" aur phir dobara "new phrase hi." Ab aap use ek hi baar, stage ke apne alfaaz mein sunte hain.
entries.ec6837d364d42: $~Humne woh masla theek kar diya jis mein stage aap ke edit karte waqt oonchi aawaaz mein apna bayaan karta tha. Ab woh play dabane tak intezaar karta hai, is liye aap ki typing ke beech mein nahin bolta.

entries.e988a8db81452: $~Humne woh masla theek kar diya jis mein @Phrase, @Group, ya @Stage par aap ki apni likhi hui wazahat nazar-andaaz ho jaati thi. Ab aap ki apni wazahat parhi jaati hai.

entries.e6157584f6379: $~Humne woh masla theek kar diya jis mein aap ke code ke aakhir mein \~\ likhne par editor narangi rang ke ghalti ke dibbe par atak jaata tha.
entries.ef938cfc06917: $~Agar kabhi editor aap ka code na bana sake, to ab jo dibba aata hai woh batata hai ke kya ghalat hua aur dobara koshish karne ka button deta hai, aur aap ko bina raaste ke nahin chhorta.
entries.e238f3a60f613: $~Humne us nishaan ko theek kar diya jo dikhata hai ke code kahan gum hai. Ab woh khaali jagah mein ek underline hai, jo aap ke baqi code ki underlines ke barabar hai.

entries.e5ade58dc4e94: $~Humne Games numaish gah mein ek naya misali mansooba <Show and Tell@https://wordplay.dev/project/example-ShowAndTell?mode=play> shaamil kiya. entries.e56dc810decb7: $~Humne ek pause ka nishaan shaamil kiya jo aap ke mansooba ke output par us waqt dikhta hai jab woh chal nahin raha, taake saaf ho ke ghadi ya animation kyun ruk gaya hai.

entries.e975a7f5f910a: $~Humne remix karna shaamil kiya: jab aap koi mansooba copy karte hain to hum asal mansooba ka link dikhate hain aur uske banane wale ko shabaash dete hain. entries.ef904d6541071: $~Character picker ab aap ke <apne banaye hue characters@https://wordplay.dev/characters> bhi dhoond sakta hai — naam ya mauzoo ka koi hissa likhein, to milte julte emoji aur nishaan nazar aa jayenge. (<669@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/669>)

entries.ec5ffec9546dc: $~<Rehnuma@https://wordplay.dev/guide>, tarjume ka safha, feedback form aur character picker ab tabs istemaal karte hain, aur aap ka chuna hua tab neeche ke mawad se jud jata hai.
entries.e480340c4f076: $~Humne <Numaish gahon@https://wordplay.dev/galleries> ko tabs mein baant diya — aap ki apni, misaalein, tareeqa guide aur aam — aur har tab ka apna web address hai jo aap baant sakte hain.
entries.e6f52ed2367d9: $~<Seekhein@https://wordplay.dev/learn> par humne sabaq chunne wala, talaash aur jaani hui zubaan chunne wala hissa mukhtasar aur mukammal tabs ke neeche kar diya.
entries.e9313d83d58b6: $~Humne "duplicate" button ka naam badal kar "remix" rakh diya hai aur ise naya nishaan diya hai. (<788@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/788>)

entries.e06fb80022e3f: $~Jab aap character picker mein talaash karte hain, to bhaarti shisha wala tab nazar aata hai aur chuna hua rehta hai; doosra tab chunne se talaash saaf ho jati hai.
entries.ecd2bb903e30b: $~Humne tezi se likhte waqt hone wala crash theek kar diya hai, aur ab aap ke likhte rehne par editor khud-ba-khud chupke se theek ho jata hai.

entries.ea3e2f6910187: $~Humne woh matn theek kiya jo "@wordplay" ko aam alfaaz ki tarah dikhata tha, aise link ki jagah jis par aap click kar sakein, jaise <donate page@https://wordplay.dev/donate> par.
entries.e0cb3c097739c: $~Humne peele background par chhupe hue link theek kiye, jaise editor mein madad ka link; ab woh safed hain aur un ke neeche narangi lakeer hai.

entries.e0b59d3fc8889: $~Humne intikhaab ke button ke groups theek kiye, jaise dark aur light mode chunne wala; ab aap group tak ek baar tab dabate hain, phir teer wali kunjiyan istemaal karte hain.
entries.e9d3408b55dff: $~Humne intikhaab ke button theek kiye jo screen reader ko apna tooltip parh kar sunate the; ab woh apna label batate hain, jis se awaaz se control mein bhi madad milti hai.
entries.e70f107162321: $~Humne drop-down menu theek kiye jo apne alfaaz kaat dete the; ab woh poori chaudai bhar dete hain jo unhein milti hai.
entries.e087477faeeed: $~Humne <Learn@https://wordplay.dev/learn> par sabaq chunne wala theek kiya jo aikt ke aaghaz mein khaali nazar aata tha. Ab woh woh sabaq dikhata hai jis par aap hain.
entries.ec9519d0ec6b7: $~Humne woh masla theek kiya jis mein mahfooz na kiye hue mansoobe bhejay bina jama hote rehte the jabke button kehta tha ke woh mahfooz ho chuke hain; ab woh groups mein bheje jaate hain aur button aap ko khabardar karta hai jab kuch abhi mahfooz karna baqi ho.
entries.effeb4f49021f: $~Humne woh masla theek kiya jis mein Wordplay aap ke device se mansooba mita deta tha pehle is ke ke aap ki tabdeeliyan cloud tak pahunchein; ab woh mansooba tabhi hatata hai jab aap ka kaam mahfooz ho jaye.
entries.e207a320ad1e0: $~Humne khaali <custom characters@https://wordplay.dev/characters> theek kiye jo chunne wale mein nazar nahin aate the; ab woh toot-ti hui lakeeron wale dibbe ki tarah dikhte hain.
entries.e0be825134a74: $~Humne aap ke naam ke saath wala harf theek kiya jo mita diye jaane par \@you/Star\ jaise matn mein badal jata tha; ab woh khaali dibba dikhata hai.

entries.e35935aa5806c: $~Humne woh masla theek kiya jis mein pause par jaane se, jo shuru par wapas le jata hai, phir play par jaane se mansooba ruk jata tha. Output khaali ho jata tha aur dobara kabhi nahin hilta tha. Ab woh chalta hai.
entries.e838e6e44ca42: $~Ab hum mansooba chalne se pehle aap ko khabardar karte hain agar woh chamak sakta ho ya tezi se hil sakta ho, aur aap use chalane ke liye Start par click karte hain. entries.ed67484a81528: $~Humne aap ke camera aur microphone ko seedha dekhne ke liye preview panel shaamil kiye, jin mein haath aur chehre ke nuqte, awaaz ki tezi, aur surr ek hilti hui lakeer ki shakal mein dikhaye jaate hain.
entries.eb066214d3ffe: $~Humne heads-up display ke liye \overlay\ mein ek \@Stage\ shaamil kiya — screen par chipka hua mawaad ki fehrist jo camera kahin bhi dekhe apni jagah par rehti hai, taake score ya label ek tai jagah par rahe.
entries.e11a581ba317e: $~Humne un mansoobon ke saath dekhne ka button shaamil kiya jinhein aap edit nahin kar sakte, jaise kisi aur ki numaish gah mein, taake aap un ka code kholein aur dekhein ke woh kaise kaam karte hain.
entries.e2e214f02948b: $~Humne Games numaish gah mein <Humming Bird@https://wordplay.dev/project/example-HummingBird?mode=play> shaamil kiya: click karke, kunjiyan dabake, ya gungunakar ek parinde ko rukawaton ke beech se udayein.
entries.edbfc8a67a72a: $~Humne Games numaish gah mein ek naya misaal <Heart Attack@https://wordplay.dev/project/example-HeartAttack?mode=play> shaamil kiya: camera se zombies ke maidan ko dekhein, daayein baayein chalein, aur dil phenkein taake woh sab tumhare paas pahunchne se pehle wapas khush logon mein badal jayein.
entries.e75c7b0ec6015: $~Humne <Code Gap@https://wordplay.dev/project/example-CodeGap?mode=play> shaamil kiya, jo computer science ki digriyon mein mard aur aurat ke farq ke data ki tasveeri numaish hai.
entries.e0af5a6c7bd35: $~Humne Games numaish gah mein <Building Blocks@https://wordplay.dev/project/example-BuildingBlocks?mode=play> shaamil kiya: darakht aur patthar kaat kar lakdi aur eent banayein, phir unhein ek khaake se milane ke liye jodein. entries.e2aeb8a131bd3: $~Humne <Slide Show@https://wordplay.dev/project/example-SlideShow?mode=play> shaamil kiya, ek misaal jo dikhata hai ke slides ki ek silsila keyboard se kaise chalayein.
entries.ed0653371d6eb: $~Humne <Guide@https://wordplay.dev/guide> mein ek tareeqa guide shaamil kiya jo dikhata hai ke teer wali kunjiyon se mawaad ke beech kaise chalein, ek fehrist, \@Key\, aur ek adad ke saath. (<756@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/756>)
entries.eeb15e4879fd3: $~Humne mansooba footer mein mansooba layout badalne ka ek tez tareeqa shaamil kiya, jo mojooda layout bhi dikhata hai.
entries.efa0f173a43e6: $~Humne Japani, Marathi, aur Bengali tarjumon ko behtar banaya, taake woh platform aur uski istilahaat se zyada mel khaayein.
entries.e9830183b8622: $~Humne stage ke upar teen halaton wala switcher shamil kiya: ✏️ edit stage ko roak deta hai, ⏸️ step aapke program ko timeline par qadam ba qadam chalata hai, aur ▶️ play usay poori screen par chalata hai. (<859@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/859>, <864@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/864>)
entries.e41b5459a3848: $~Humne \@Motion\ aur \@Collision\ ke peeche chalne wale physics engine ko ek tez engine se badal diya, is liye jin mansoobon mein bohat si cheezein hilti aur takraati hain woh ab zyada hamwaar chalte hain. entries.e14f818e941b0: $~Humne programming zubaan mein ek bada naya rukn shaamil kiya hai: patterns! Inhein "regular expressions" bhi kehte hain. Milan ko qadam ba qadam chalaya ja sakta hai, is liye aap ek qadam chala kar dekh sakte hain ke position kaise aage barhti hai aur pakde gaye hisse kaise bharte hain, bilkul baqi evaluation ki tarah.
